facts.fact: Turbo Putt（Lubbock 的高档迷你高尔夫球场）18 号洞下面有一条地下隧道，把打完的球送回 Jules Estrada 居住兼工作的破旧主办公室棚屋；隧道最初是为了防顾客把免费球顺走。
facts.anchor: It was like a waterslide for golf balls, a recycling system to carry each ball through the earth and back to its starting point in the dilapidated main office shed where Jules Estrada lived and worked.

facts.fact: 开门后 ten a.m. sharp（上午十点整），一名 Jules 认出是高中校友的金发女生敲金属格栅窗，点名要粉色高尔夫球；她高中时曾因 Jules 在数学课上用嘴吹泡泡而叫他们 “the Aquarium”。
facts.anchor: Today, for instance, this pretty blond girl whom Jules immediately recognized from high school was here at ten a.m. sharp, right after opening, knocking on the big metal grate and asking Jules not just for any golf ball, but for a pink golf ball specifically.

facts.fact: 隧道曾堵塞，经理从 Dallas 的 McMansion 调来施工队挖开球场修理，a week and a half（一周半）没人能打球，Jules 期间拿到了 PTO 带薪假。
facts.anchor: Those guys brought a big tractor down to the Turbo Putt and no one could golf for a week and a half as they dug up the course and worked on repairs. Jules got PTO.

facts.fact: 两年多（two-plus years）后，Jules 打完 David Sawyer 的 Public Access Afterworld 游戏此前的全部挑战，进入最终挑战 “Pink Eye TV”：按论坛指示 “Narrate an episode of the TV show stuck in your brain, then upload your video”。
facts.anchor: It was called Pink Eye TV. According to this final message board, everyone who was truly destined for Public Access Afterworld had a psychic connection to at least one specific TV show, even if they’d never actually watched it in real life. Even if it didn’t exist yet.

facts.fact: Jules 把假电视节目定名 “Golf Ball Revolution”：一颗红色高尔夫球联合桶里其他球堵死地下管道拒绝出来，等施工队挖开地面时发起攻击，第一季末占领整个球场、把人类变成人形高尔夫球；当晚又补构思了 cold open（来捣乱的高中橄榄球队四分卫被高尔夫球从体内贯穿）。
facts.anchor: there would be one red-colored golf ball who got so sick of getting smacked around the course every single day that they made a secret plan with the other golf balls in the bucket to lodge themselves in the underground tubing system and refuse to come out.

facts.fact: Jules 的固定药物日程：早晨一粒 edible 加一 bump 的 K，下午 4:20 一粒 edible，关店后一根 joint、一条 line、两粒 pills。
facts.anchor: So they had an edible and a bump of K in the morning, another edible in the afternoon (at 4:20, of course, lol), and then a joint, a line, and two pills after close to celebrate the end of another day at the Turbo Putt.

facts.fact: 当晚 Jules 按下录制键，照 David Sawyer 秘密论坛的指示说出开场白并讲完 Golf Ball Revolution 的故事；回看后认为节目 “totally sucked”，决定不上传、换全新点子从头再来。
facts.anchor: watching Pink Eye TV, and this is the first episode of the TV show stuck in my head,” they said, just like the instructions on David Sawyer’s secret forum had told them to do.

facts.fact: 次日下午 one p.m.（一点）Jules 才醒、迟开 Turbo Putt 整整一小时；来的还是那个金发女生，Jules 认出她是 GlobalVill.com 的老视频作者——当年更年轻、还是个男孩——最后她隔着棚屋窗户伸出手说 “I’m Bethany Peters”。
